name: Chart
description: Renders a bar, line, scatter, histogram, pie, boxplot, heatmap or world bubble map from the input table and passes the table through unchanged. A visible title, subtitle, axis labels and units are drawn on the canvas; axes get 5% headroom, bars start at 0 and sort by value by default. Pie slices show shares with percentages, boxplots draw quartiles with whiskers and outliers, heatmaps aggregate means per cell with a colour legend, and maps project lat/lng bubbles over a bundled public-domain Natural Earth 110m outline. SVG is hand-written XML with rounded coordinates and no timestamps, so the same input produces byte-identical output; PNG is drawn with Java2D in headless mode.

file.title: Output file
file.description: Absolute path of the .svg or .png file to write; parent directories are created.

format.title: Format
format.description: svg is deterministic and golden-tested; png is drawn with Java2D.

type.title: Chart type
type.description: bar - summed values per category; line/scatter - points over a numeric x; histogram - distribution of the x column; pie - shares of one y column per category; boxplot - quartiles and outliers of one y column per category; heatmap - mean of one y column per x/series cell; map - lat/lng bubble map over a world outline.

x.title: X column
x.description: Category column for bar/pie/boxplot/heatmap; numeric column for line, scatter and histogram; not used by map.

y.title: Y columns
y.description: Numeric value columns. bar, pie, boxplot and heatmap take exactly one; line and scatter take one or more (one series each); histogram takes none.

series.title: Series column
series.description: Column that splits values into series: one bar group, line or point colour per value, or the heatmap row axis. bar/line/scatter take at most one y column with series; heatmap requires it.

title.title: Title
title.description: Visible chart title, also used for the SVG <title> element.

x_label.title: X axis label
x_label.description: Text under the x axis; combined with x_unit as 'label (unit)'.

y_label.title: Y axis label
y_label.description: Rotated text next to the y axis; combined with y_unit as 'label (unit)'.

x_unit.title: X unit
x_unit.description: Unit appended to the x axis label.

y_unit.title: Y unit
y_unit.description: Unit appended to the y axis label.

sort.title: Category sort
sort.description: Category order: by aggregated value (bar default, descending), by label, or input order.

sort_direction.title: Sort direction
sort_direction.description: Direction for sort=value/label; defaults to desc for value and asc for label.

log_x.title: Logarithmic x axis
log_x.description: line/scatter only; all x values must be positive.

log_y.title: Logarithmic y axis
log_y.description: All y values must be positive; bar baselines at the axis minimum.

grid.title: Grid lines
grid.description: Draw horizontal grid lines at y ticks.

data_labels.title: Data labels
data_labels.description: Print the value next to each bar, point or slice.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Text notes placed on the canvas.

x.title: X
x.description: Data x for numeric axes or a category name.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum input rows read for the chart.

bins.title: Histogram bins
bins.description: Number of equal-width bins for the histogram type.

lat.title: Latitude column
lat.description: map only: numeric latitude in [-90, 90]; rows with NULL lat/lng are skipped.

size.title: Bubble size column
size.description: map only: numeric column scaled to bubble radius; adds a size legend.

color.title: Bubble colour column
color.description: map only: categorical column; one palette colour per value.

label.title: Bubble label column
label.description: map only: text drawn next to each bubble when there are at most 40 points.

facet.title: Facet column
facet.description: Split the chart into small multiples, one panel per value of this column, in one SVG/PNG. Every panel keeps its own axes; the title is shared.

facet_columns.title: Facet columns
facet_columns.description: Panels per row in a faceted chart; rows follow from the number of facet values.
